<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
$network = get_network();
$id = wp_insert_site( array( 'domain' => $network->domain, 'path' => $network->path . 'shop/', 'title' => 'Shop', 'user_id' => 1 ) );
switch_to_blog( $id );
for ( $i = 0; $i < 3; $i++ ) {
	wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Product ' . $i, 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'post' ) );
}
update_option( 'active_plugins', array( 'hello.php' ) );
restore_current_blog();
$result = activate_plugin( 'site-portrait/site-portrait.php', '', true );
echo is_wp_error( $result ) ? $result->get_error_message() : 'ok';
